privateVars.name: jobQueue
privateVars.description: RxJS Subject used as an internal job queue for manga sync requests

privateVars.name: processing
privateVars.description: Set of anilist IDs currently being processed to prevent duplicate jobs

privateVars.name: mangaRepository
privateVars.description: Repository used to upsert manga data synced from AniList

functions.name: onModuleInit
functions.description: NestJS lifecycle hook that starts processing the job queue on module initialization

functions.name: addJob
functions.description: Adds an anilist ID to the job queue if it is not already being processed

functions.name: processQueue
functions.description: Subscribes to the job queue and processes jobs sequentially (concurrency 1) with error handling

functions.name: syncMangaFromAniList
functions.description: Fetches manga data from AniList and upserts it into the repository

functions.name: fetchFromAniList
functions.description: Fetches full manga details from AniList GraphQL with retry logic (max 5 retries, exponential backoff) for rate limiting

exceptions.name: rrInternalServerErrorException
exceptions.message: Failed to fetch from AniList: No response received
